text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon was able to achieve
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through
those truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One such early afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon the intrusion, Trainy.
You eaten lunch yet?"
choice_data_list: Not yet, but... is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I made us lunch.
Care to eat together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
we ended up eating our boxed lunches together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Eating a bento under the open sky really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this kinpira has soaked up the flavor so well.
Making the tamagoyaki sweet was definitely the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The boxed lunch she prepared for me had a gentle flavor with careful attention to nutrition, just like her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Care for some tea, Trainy?
I've got it piping hot and ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A peaceful atmosphere drifted through the air. However... precisely because of that, there was a slight cause for concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's not the type to space out aimlessly.
Does she have something she wants to talk about?
Thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nope. Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she stares blankly,
I explain the situation, feeling a bit flustered...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! What on earth is that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing particularly special going on.
Just... I felt like relaxing for once."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've been running together
this whole time, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"And surely, I'll keep on running from here on out.
Laughing, crying, winning, losing—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Things get pretty hectic, y'know?
Knowing us, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So, I just figured it'd be nice to have
some time to do nothing every once in a while,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Here, since we're taking a break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Hishi Amazon
handed over a cup of warm tea.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you for a long time to come, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a single sip, the gentle flavor of the tea
warmed my stomach from the inside out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of
running alongside Hishi Amazon once again.
